target_buyer_1.organization: RSVP (Retired Senior Volunteer Program) - Axess Family Services
target_buyer_1.type: National Service Program / AmeriCorps Senior Corps
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: One of the largest volunteer networks in the nation for people 55 and over. Mission: engage Americans 55+ in volunteer service to meet critical community needs. Operates in 15 Ohio counties including Ashtabula. Volunteers choose how, where, and how often they want to serve (few hours to 40 hours/week). Services provided: tutoring, meal preparation/delivery, transportation, light cleaning, clerical support, food pantry assistance. Pre-service orientation training provided. Supplemental insurance while on duty. Sponsors include AmeriCorps, Area Agencies on Aging, United Way, and community foundations. Ashtabula location serves as hub for senior volunteer coordination across the county.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Major anti-poverty organization in Ashtabula County. Mission: 'Community Action helps people and changes lives. Ashtabula County Community Action will help people achieve self-sufficiency and rise above issues of poverty.' Core value: 'Our volunteers are the backbone of our agency.' Programs: Head Start, HEAP/PIPP (moving to 6920 Austinburg Road), Home Weatherization, meals for seniors/disabled (100,290 meals provided). Impact: 11,763 residents served last year, 99 households weatherized. Values: Customer service, community partnerships, interagency collaboration, continuous improvement. Dedicated volunteer page at /get-involved/volunteer.html. Volunteer scheduling platform would strengthen their 'backbone' volunteer management.
